A Jeopardy Milestone: Nancy Zerg Ends Ken Jennings' Reign

Twenty years ago today, on November 9, 2004, television history was made. Nancy Zerg, a real estate agent from Ventura, California, defeated Ken Jennings, ending his unprecedented 74-game winning streak on Jeopardy!

Jennings, who had captivated audiences with his extraordinary knowledge and quick wit, walked away with a staggering $2.5 million, setting a new record for the highest-ever game show winnings.

However, Jennings' Jeopardy! journey was far from over. He would return to the show multiple times to compete in future tournaments, further bolstering his impressive total winnings to $4.5 million. | Did You Catch This? | Facebook
